title: Claude Desktop 优先：官方视觉与交互证据账本
scope: Official public documentary evidence; Desktop prioritized. Does not claim signed-in runtime inspection.

sources.title: Install Claude Desktop
sources.time: Current page retrieved 2026-10-14; relative update label varies by fetch
claims: Linux beta is officially supported on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS+/Debian 12+, x64/arm64.
Official signing key and apt repository are hosted under downloads.claude.ai/claude-desktop.
Linux omits computer use and dictation; Quick Entry on native Wayland depends on GlobalShortcuts portal.
limits: Not a signed-in UI screenshot.
Its statement that direct .deb installation does not opt into updates conflicts with OV02.

sources.title: Claude Desktop on Linux (beta)
claims: Official package index path: https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-desktop/apt/stable/dists/stable/main/binary-amd64/Packages .
Key fingerprint: 31DDDE24DDFAB679F42D7BD2BAA929FF1A7ECACE.
Desktop uses account/SSO sign-in and does not accept a Claude Console API key directly.
The page says direct .deb install registers the apt repo unless CLAUDE_DESKTOP_ADD_REPO=false.
Linux Cowork local VM requirements include QEMU/KVM and access to /dev/kvm and /dev/vhost-vsock.
limits: Documentation, not a successful local install or verified package signature.
VM-based Cowork wording coexists with newer cloud-task wording elsewhere; scope and rollout need care.

sources.title: Download Claude
claims: Official download destination lists macOS, Windows, Windows arm64 and Linux documentation.
Desktop differentiators include Quick Entry and desktop extensions; ordinary conversations, projects, memory and preferences sync when signed in.
limits: The page is a distribution/marketing surface, not the authenticated desktop UI.
Do not infer app typography or spacing from this webpage.

sources.title: Navigating the Claude desktop app
claims: Quick Entry is an always-in-front compact window above other apps.
Desktop folder access is attached below the message box.
The built-in browser is a side panel beside the task, with tabs/history separate from the user's own browser.
Mac screenshot and Caps Lock speech shortcuts are differentiated from Windows/Linux hotkey behavior.
limits: Embedded visual material returned as Loading; no independently inspected frames.
Current text has broader shortcut support than the older Mac Quick Entry FAQ.

sources.title: Use quick entry with Claude Desktop on Mac
sources.time: Article date March 16, 2026; embedded screenshot filename dated 2025-12-18
claims: Mac Quick Entry opens via double Option; screenshot capture, window attachment and dictation share the compact entry flow.
Settings place shortcut controls under General / Desktop app.
The entry arrow or Enter submits a message.
limits: Mac-specific design; not evidence of Linux feature parity.
FAQ says no Windows Quick Entry, conflicting with newer Academy and Linux docs. Screenshot age differs from page update date.

sources.title: Get started with Claude
claims: The plus control at lower left and slash input expose additional options.
Model selection is documented below input on web/desktop and at screen top on mobile.
Contains a 1442×334 composer screenshot asset.
limits: The general platform list omits Linux even though installer-specific sources include it.
Crop alone cannot establish native desktop chrome, full layout, current font identity or exact live CSS.

sources.title: Customizing your appearance settings
claims: Color mode options are Light, Match System and Dark.
Chat font options are Default, Match System and Dyslexic Friendly.
Sidebar can be collapsed or opened from its top-right control but cannot be completely disabled.
limits: Confirms controls, not actual light/dark color tokens or named font families.
No screenshot measurement was performed.

sources.title: Use voice mode
claims: Desktop/web voice entry is a waveform control at lower right, replaced by a Stop action while active.
Mobile waveform entry sits next to a microphone, separating conversation voice from dictation.
Contains four screenshot crops showing those controls and mobile voice settings.
limits: Article combines web and desktop; crop does not prove which host generated it.
Beta availability and UI may vary.

sources.title: Use dictation on Claude Mobile
claims: Microphone control on the right of input records a written prompt; arrow submits and X cancels.
This flow returns text replies and is distinct from two-way voice mode.
limits: Mobile behavior only; Linux desktop explicitly lacks dictation.

sources.title: Change the model, effort, and thinking settings
sources.time: Current article updated this week; read 2026-10-14
claims: The model menu sits next to Send and nests model, effort and thinking controls.
Thinking is represented by a timed activity indicator and expandable section above the response.
Admin policy and model capability change which choices appear.
limits: No screenshot images found in live HTML.
Do not report a fixed universally available menu or reconstruct pixel geometry from prose.

sources.title: Claude Cowork and chat are one Claude
claims: New experience merges Chat and Cowork into the same conversation without choosing a mode.
Rollout starts with Pro and Max across web, desktop and mobile; same-plan accounts may receive it at different times.
Presence of Chat/Cowork choices in composer identifies an account not yet migrated; no switch back after migration.
limits: A current screenshot from one account is not universal evidence.
Older three-tab documentation can remain valid for some accounts.

sources.title: Get started with Claude Cowork
claims: Legacy/current-overlap path uses the same home and a Chat/Cowork choice in message box.
Task execution presents progress and can be steered while working.
Contains one 1500×750 screenshot near global instruction settings.
limits: Explicit migration note means steps and images are not uniformly current.
Some platform lists and local/cloud descriptions differ across current official pages.

sources.title: Use the built-in browser in Claude Cowork
claims: A browser opens in a side panel beside the task; links from transcript open in that panel.
Browser preference lives under Settings > Cowork and can choose built-in browser or Chrome extension.
Built-in browser is separate from personal browser and relies on desktop app online.
limits: No screenshot images in retrieved HTML.
Settings naming may reflect pre-merge account state.

sources.title: What are artifacts and how do I use them?
claims: Artifacts created before September 16, 2026 are legacy; new creation uses the newer artifact model.
Output in composer and Artifacts sidebar gallery offer Docs, Slides, Design and gated Dashboards/Motion templates.
Artifacts open beside conversation; template outputs support direct editing.
On mobile, artifact viewing/editing is supported but sharing settings require web/desktop.
limits: Availability varies by plan and admin; Enterprise default enablement is stated for October 15, 2026, after this research date.
This source provides workflow, not exact visual tokens.

sources.title: Get started with Claude Design
claims: Design is available from a conversation, Output menu, Artifacts tab or Claude Code.
The editor organizes top bar, artboard canvas, properties panel and a floating selection toolbar.
Inline comments, chat and direct manipulation serve different editing scales.
Standalone claude.ai/design is scheduled to close December 14, 2026.
limits: The product name Claude Design must not be confused with analysis of Claude's own design.
Official limitations include keyboard insertion gaps, comment persistence issues and no version history.

sources.title: Get started with Claude Docs
claims: Docs open beside conversations on desktop and full-screen from Artifacts on mobile.
Rich text, document tabs, comments and direct editing are part of the interface.
Narrow panels show comments as margin icons; wider panels show comments beside text.
Docs can be started through Output > Docs or /docs.
limits: Documents' own typography is not the shell's typography.
The page reports VoiceOver editing limitations in Desktop; cannot claim comprehensive accessibility conformance.

sources.title: Use artifacts with a keyboard or screen reader
claims: Artifact panel consists of header controls and content below.
Tab/Return enters the panel/content; Escape moves outward through nested editing scopes.
F6 switches editor regions; shortcuts differ by operating system.
limits: Documented keyboard support is not a tested WCAG audit.
Another source's mobile editing availability does not establish identical keyboard behavior on mobile.

sources.title: Desktop application — Claude Code
claims: Code supports rearrangeable panes: chat, diff, browser, terminal, file, plan, tasks and subagents.
Titlebar controls and an overflow menu adapt to available width; panes can be undocked.
Transcript density modes distinguish Normal, Thinking and Verbose.
Model/permission selection, context usage ring, file references, diff review and CI status are described.
limits: Scope is Code tab, not general Chat.
Intro still describes three tabs, unlike merged-chat rollout page.
Version thresholds are documented; do not generalize to older app builds.

sources.title: Get started with the desktop app — Claude Code
claims: Code is documented at top center, with environment/folder/model/permission choices before starting.
Changes can be reviewed through a diff with accept/reject actions depending on permission mode.
limits: Current text retains three-tab framing; actual account/build must be labeled.

sources.title: Release notes
claims: July 7, 2026 entry: Cowork expands to web/mobile and shares one home with Chat.
September 16, 2026 entry: mode-free conversation rollout plus designs/decks/docs in any conversation.
Earlier artifacts/screenshots cannot be silently presented as the September-generation UI.
limits: A dated launch is not proof every account has the feature that day.
Use help page for later availability updates.

sources.title: Collaborate with Claude on Projects
claims: Contains official historical app screenshots of document upload, custom instructions, side-by-side artifact/chat, and shared project chats.
Side-by-side creation was already an explicit product pattern in 2024.
limits: Historical web UI, not current desktop.
No visual measurements or pixel inspection completed in this worker.

sources.title: Artifacts are now generally available
claims: Artifacts moved from June preview to general availability and iOS/Android creation/viewing.
The artifact as a dedicated window dates from this earlier generation.
limits: Availability and behavior have since changed; chronology evidence only.

sources.time: main branch read 2026-10-14; not pinned to commit

limits: Not the implementation/design-token specification of Claude Desktop.

claims: Original identity used Styrene from Commercial Type and Tiempos from Klim.

sources.title: Anthropic Brand Team Interview
claims: Tim Belonax describes the serif as bookish and the sans as synthetic, balancing human and technological associations.
Palette is associated with unfired clay; illustration with informal doodling.
Chelsea Larsson frames Claude as collaborator and distinguishes Claude's expression from Anthropic's institutional role.
limits: Reported statements from named employees at that date; not a CSS specification or usability outcome.
Design intention does not prove measurable trust, legibility or performance gains.

sources.title: Anthropic — by Everett
